title: Local Indices Are Not Enough: Synchrony and Global Information in Bandit Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2611.33056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard index-based stochastic bandit algorithms such as KL-UCB and Thompson Sampling achieve optimal $O(\log T)$ regret over a horizon $T$. The former uses the global timestep to construct each arm's index, while the latter samples each arm's belief distribution at every timestep. The necessity of global information and synchronous index updates for achieving optimal regret has not been examined yet. In this paper, we investigate the fundamental limits of asynchronous local index algorithms---those that recalculate an arm's index only upon pulling it, using solely that arm's own reward history and a local randomness budget. We prove that no such algorithm can achieve $O(\log T)$ regret across all bandit instances. We then analyse the functional equations arising from asynchronous updates, and show that the achievable regret lies in a sub-polynomial, super-polylogarithmic regime. translated_title: 局部指数并不足够：多臂老虎机算法中的同步性与全局信息
translated_abstract: 诸如 KL-UCB 和 Thompson Sampling 等基于指数的标准随机多臂老虎机算法能够在时间范围 T 内实现最优的 O(log T) 遗憾值。前者利用全局时间步来构建每个臂的指数，而后者在每个时间步对每个臂的信念分布进行采样。然而，全局信息和同步指数更新对于实现最优遗憾值是否必要，此前尚未被考察。在本文中，我们研究了异步局部指数算法的根本局限——这类算法仅在拉取某个臂时才重新计算该臂的指数，且仅使用该臂自身的奖励历史和一个局部随机性预算。我们证明了这类算法无法在所有多臂老虎机实例上都实现 O(log T) 的遗憾值。随后，我们分析了由异步更新产生的函数方程，并表明可实现的遗憾值处于亚多项式、超多对数的区间。我们提出了一种异步局部指数策略，其遗憾值（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了仅依赖臂自身历史和局部随机性的异步指数型多臂老虎机算法无法在所有实例上达到 O(log T) 的最优遗憾值，其遗憾值只能处于亚多项式但超多对数的区间，从而揭示了全局时间信息与同步指数更新对于最优性能的必要性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that asynchronous local-index bandit algorithms using only an arm's own reward history and local randomness cannot achieve O(log T) regret on all instances, showing that global time information and synchronous index updates are essential for optimal regret.
